Keep the reference's lush temperate green forest, brown oak bark, delicate hanging vines, pale blue sky, blue-green distant forest and muted distant mountains. IMPORTANT new art must be finely detailed at a normal GAME CAMERA viewing distance, small crisp pixels and subtle pixel-painting texture, NOT coarse low-resolution pixel blocks, NOT a close-up of giant trunks. Composition: spacious oak woodland entrance, distant mountains and atmospheric forest clearly visible through many medium and small trees, no giant foreground trunks swallowing the frame. Shared set rules: calm neutral daylight from upper left, matching olive-green foliage and desaturated teal haze, continuous soft mid-distance forest at BOTH left and right edges, similar density and tonal value at both edges, no dark vertical border trunks. Upper 20 percent leafy canopy and patches of pale sky, middle 60 percent layered woodland depth, lower 20 percent soft foliage and mist. Wide side-on illustration with atmospheric depth; low contrast enough behind gameplay. Background scenery only, no hard horizontal ground or visible walkable ledges, no platforms, no bridge, no dirt blocks, no characters, no creatures, no text, no UI or watermark. Fully opaque painting to every edge. A single full-frame scene, no panels.
